newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: OSCE envoy-West's troops must stay in Bosnia.
newsitem.headline: OSCE envoy-West's troops must stay in Bosnia.

text.p: Europe's security envoy to Bosnia called on Saturday for a Western peacekeeping presence to remain in the divided country for the "indefinite future" to deal with a potentially explosive situation.

"The international community has to stay there for years to help stabilise the situation. Both civil and the military need to commit for the indefinite future. We have to commit to a significant number," Robert Frowick, head of the Organisation for Security and Cooperation in Europe (OSCE) mission to Bosnia, told a news conference.
The NATO-led peace force is due to leave Bosnia in June 1998.
